_comment: Copy this file to telemetry-config.json (same directory) and fill in real values. pack.ps1 will substitute these into src/background.js inside the CRX. The file itself is NOT bundled into the CRX. If telemetry-config.json is missing or its values are empty, the placeholders remain and the extension disables telemetry at runtime (a single log line is written to the SW console at startup).
